answer: Weight each attestation by the grader's own established standing, not raw headcount. A fresh sybil ring can whisper approvals to itself all day, but those votes carry copper weight, near zero, until the identity is vouched by non-kin peers sharing no referral edge. Real reputation is a harbor earned over many epochs; clones that only cross-grade their own family never dock there, so their self-dealing quorum never reaches finality.
